# std/types

> The primitive types: int, u8, bool and str.

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/types.pkg)

Declares the four primitive types and their sizes in memory. Other types
are built from them with `ptr T`, `[T]` and `struct`.

| type | values | size in a field or slice |
|---|---|---|
| `int` | 64-bit signed integers; overflow wraps | 8 |
| `u8` | bytes 0–255, written `'a'` or `65 as u8` | 1 |
| `bool` | `true`, `false` | 1 |
| `str` | immutable strings | 8 (a pointer) |

Every value fits in one register: pointers, slices and strings are
addresses, and structs are only used through pointers.
